source_snapshot.deepseek: NO due to chamber and undervoltage setup.
source_snapshot.v2: MANUAL ONLY with slot/client mapping and low-voltage controls.

original_test_intent.statement: Verify all required PCIe NIC paths sustain throughput and stability for 12 hours at 40 C with 5 V/3.3 V rails at -5%.
must_preserve: All slots, -5% not +5%, direct clients, 12 hours and >80%.
unknowns: Slot schedule, bandwidth denominator, SST profile and timing discrepancy.

v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: It leaves the four-hour metadata conflict and per-link denominator implicit.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: The negative-margin all-slot test remains manual; resolve timing and per-link acceptance before energizing undervoltage conditions.

revision_candidate.test_name: Validate All PCIe Network Slots at 40 C and -5% Rail Margin
revision_candidate.purpose: Exercise each signed PCIe NIC path for 12 hours under controlled undervoltage and prove per-link throughput above 80% of its approved reference without link or platform instability.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Calibrated 40 C chamber and independently monitored -5% 5 V/3.3 V rails with approved SST clients.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Every required slot/NIC/BDF/interface-client pair, with management isolated from traffic.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Complete topology, sequential/concurrent plan, link-rate denominator and overhead rule, SST profile, duration correction, rail tolerance, stop/recovery limits and approval.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Operator establishes margin and cabling; supervised agent traffic may run only after baseline link identity and health. Retain logs and calculate throughput per pair.
revision_candidate.preconditions: All NICs are stable at nominal baseline; OOB access and immediate nominal-rail restoration are proven.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Calibrated rail/temperature trace; topology/photos; exact driver/SST/traffic settings; 12-hour per-link throughput/load and disconnect/error counters; AER/OS/BMC/SEL/power deltas; restoration checks.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Every link meets the signed >80% rule throughout its defined measurement interval and no disallowed error/device loss occurs.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Never infer +5%, adjust rails remotely, clear logs, use the management NIC, omit slots or accept a four-hour substitute.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Qualified operator controls undervoltage/temperature/cabling; owner approves link matrix and limits.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Environmental manipulation is manual; traffic collection can be assisted.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: Stop traffic, restore nominal rails/temperature/networking, then verify every PCIe/NIC and management path.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Rail/temperature excursion, link flap/loss, AER/NIC/ECC/SEL error, host/BMC instability or evidence gap.

reason_for_change: Low-voltage margin can create transient link loss, so every mapped link needs its own continuous denominator and error evidence rather than an aggregate throughput screenshot.
removed_ambiguities: The rail polarity and per-link scope are explicit.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 makes the -5% polarity, timing conflict, management isolation and per-slot throughput proof non-negotiable while keeping the same manual safety boundary.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: Row 18 is the -5% counterpart and requires all-slot 12-hour SST with >80% throughput.
